description: Read-only: the Universal Manifold Controller tip, the KV buckets it seals to (UMC_LONG_PLAY, C4_STATES, JORDAN_BONDS), the four Long Play domains, the NATS subjects it publishes on (gaiaftcl.umc.state.> and gaiaftcl.agent.state.>) and the documented MCP tool surface. Takes no arguments, advances nothing, and is safe to call at any rate. Use it to discover what umc_direct and umc_resume will act on.
name: umc_status
